overview.en:
Draft and schedule social posts, analyze performance and manage approvals with Ordinal’s official OAuth MCP connector.

Turn channel context into draft posts and a reviewable publishing schedule. Keep channels, audience, and campaign goals explicit when assessing content performance.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Ordinal 官方 OAuth MCP 连接器起草和排期社媒帖子、分析表现并管理审批。

结合渠道信息准备帖子草稿与可审阅的发布计划，分析内容表现时明确渠道、受众和活动目标。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Draft three posts for this campaign tailored to my connected channels.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这次活动起草三条适配已连接渠道的帖子。

starterPrompts.en: Review last week's available post performance and suggest what to test next.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 复盘上周可用的帖子表现，建议下一步测试内容。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare next week's publishing schedule for review before scheduling posts.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 准备下周发布计划供审阅，先不要安排发布。
